events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes thought for a moment that the Chiefs were headed to overtime. So did Ravens counterpart Lamar Jackson, who had found Isaiah Likely in the back of the end zone with no time left for a touchdown that appeared to tie the game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs hold off Ravens 27-20 when review overturns TD on final play of NFL's season opener

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Saquon Barkley has been practicing the art of positive thinking since switching teams for the first time in his career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barkley scores 3 TDs as Eagles beat Packers 34-29 in Brazil. Packers' Love injured in final minute

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — With all eyes on the quarterbacks, Chris Boswell's strong right leg stole the spotlight in the season opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fields steps in for Wilson, Boswell boots 6 field goals to lead Steelers past Falcons 18-10

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — For all the changes the Buffalo Bills had at wide receiver and on defense this offseason, the one big constant that remained was quarterback Josh Allen.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen throws 2 TD passes and runs for 2 others as Bills rally for 34-28 win over Cardinals

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — This wasn't exactly the debut Caleb Williams envisioned. Good thing for him, his defense made just enough plays.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams has a rough debut but gets bailed out by Bears' defense in 24-17 win over Titans

events.name: New England Patriots at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Jacoby Brissett didn't have to be spectacular in his first start for the Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots win Jerod Mayo's debut as coach, beating mistake-prone Bengals 16-10

events.name: Houston Texans at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — The Houston Texans invested heavily in the offseason in giving C.J. Stroud some additional scoring options.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stefon Diggs, Joe Mixon combine to lead Texans past Colts 29-27 in season opener

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — For the Miami Dolphins, the day started with chaos and ended with celebration.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jason Sanders makes 52-yard field goal as time expires and Dolphins rally past Jaguars 20-17

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — It took Derek Carr and the Saints' new offense one series to produce a touchdown on an explosive play — and one half to score 30 points.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derek Carr and the Saints rout the Panthers 47-10 in Klint Kubiak's play-calling debut

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Sam Darnold had one of those super performances at MetLife Stadium that New York Jets fans hoped to see weekly after he was drafted No. 3 overall in 2018.
headlines.shortLinkText: Darnold throws 2 TD passes and Van Ginkel scores on a 1-handed INT as Vikings easily top Giants 28-6

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — J.K. Dobbins had some of his biggest games in college against Jim Harbaugh.
headlines.shortLinkText: J.K. Dobbins rushes for 135 yards as the Chargers beat the Raiders 22-10 in Jim Harbaugh's debut

events.name: Denver Broncos at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — The first two plays of Mike Macdonald's career as a head coach started by watching his quarterback get sacked and throw an interception while being hit as he threw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenneth Walker III sparks Seahawks rally as Seattle tops Denver 26-20 in Mike Macdonald's debut

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott barely had time to celebrate getting the biggest contract in NFL history before learning it came with a price.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott leads Cowboys to 33-17 romp over Browns in opener after getting new 4-year contract

events.name: Washington Commanders at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers are indisputably Baker Mayfield's team. However, Mike Evans, Chris Godwin and a solid defense are still a big part of their formula for success.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker Mayfield and Buccaneers rout Commanders 37-20 to spoil Jayden Daniels' debut

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions opened the season by outlasting the Los Angeles Rams with a balanced offense, grinding out yards on the ground and going to the air for some pivotal plays just as they did in their NFC wild-card game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montgomery's 1-yard touchdown run in OT lifts Lions to 26-20 win over Rams

events.name: New York Jets at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Fill-in back Jordan Mason took top billing in a game hyped as Aaron Rodgers' return.
headlines.shortLinkText: The 49ers spoil Aaron Rodgers' return with a 32-19 win over the Jets

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Buffalo fans cheered so loudly in Hard Rock Stadium that Bills coach Sean McDermott was asked if it was a home game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cook scores 3 TDs to help Bills rout Dolphins 31-10, Tagovailoa leaves with concussion

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Derek Carr spent the offseason asking himself how he could have a faster start in a second season with the New Orleans Saints.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr, Kamara help Saints end Cowboys' 16-game home win streak in regular season with 44-19 win

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield took one step back, planted his left foot and took off for a zig-zagging, 11-yard touchdown run that gave Tampa Bay the lead for good in a playoff rematch.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield runs for a TD and throws a TD pass, lifting Bucs to 20-16 win over Lions in playoff rematch

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Malik Willis acknowledges he wasn’t ready the last time he had to start an NFL game. The Green Bay Packers quarterback knew he’d be more prepared the next time an opportunity arose.
headlines.shortLinkText: Willis thrives with help from the Packers' defense and running game in a 16-10 victory over Colts

events.name: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Braelon Allen, the NFL's youngest player, ran for a 20-yard touchdown with 4:31 left to put Aaron Rodgers and the New York Jets ahead to stay as they beat the Tennessee Titans 24-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braelon Allen, NFL's youngest player, scores 2 TDs to help Aaron Rodgers and Jets beat Titans 24-17

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Minnesota Vikings
Seattle Seahawks at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Jason Myers hit a 31-yard field goal in overtime to lift the Seattle Seahawks to a 23-20 win over the New England Patriots on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jason Myers hits 31-yard field goal to lift Seahawks to a 23-20 overtime win over Patriots

events.name: New York Giants at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Jayden Daniels got the wind knocked out of him, missed a snap and came back like nothing went wrong. He led the Washington Commanders down...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels gets his 1st NFL win as Commanders beat Giants on 7 field goals by Austin Seibert

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Justin Herbert threw two touchdown passes to Quentin Johnston, J.K Dobbins ran for 131 yards, including a 43-yard touchdown, and the Los Angeles Chargers drubbed the Carolina Panthers 26-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Herbert throws 2 TDs to Quentin Johnston; Chargers hammer Panthers 26-3 to remain unbeaten

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson ran for a touchdown, Dustin Hopkins kicked three field goals and the stingy Cleveland Browns did just enough to hold off the Jacksonville Jaguars 18-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson runs for a TD as the Browns shut down Lawrence and the Jaguars for an 18-13 win

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Gardner Minshew and the Raiders brushed aside years of frustration and criticism with a memorable performance on a splendid afternoon for underdogs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gardner Minshew rallies Raiders past Ravens 26-23 with 3 fourth-quarter scoring drives

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Arizona Cardinals quarterback Kyler Murray was asked about his thoughts during that spectacular play in the first half. You know, the one where he had a Houdini-like scramble to avoid trouble before figuring out a way to pick up a big gain.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Marvin Harrison Jr. catches first 2 NFL touchdowns and Cardinals roll past Rams 41-10

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Justin Fields and the Pittsburgh Steelers squeaked past the sputtering Denver Broncos 13-6 on Sunday with Russell Wilson reprising his bitter role as sideline spectator in the Mile High City.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Fields wins 2nd straight start as sub for Russell Wilson, leads Steelers past Broncos 13-6

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Harrison Butker kept making a lonely walk to midfield after each quarter Sunday to check on the direction of the wind, which tends to swirl inside Arrowhead Stadium. He did it one last time during the 2-minute warning, when his Chiefs were trailing...
headlines.shortLinkText: Butker hits a 51-yard winner for KC after penalty on Bengals safety keeps Chiefs alive

events.name: Chicago Bears at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — In a second half where C.J. Stroud and the Houston offense struggled to move the ball, the Texans' defense stepped up Sunday night to secure a win over the Chicago Bears.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud throws a TD pass and Fairbairn kicks 4 field goals to help the Texans top the Bears 19-13

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Oh, so this was what Atlanta expected out of $180 million lavished on Kirk Cousins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins caps winning drive with TD pass to London as Falcons rally past Eagles 22-21

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Aaron Rodgers was in total control in a superb homecoming performance that kept the cheers and chants going from the giddy New York Jets fans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers sparkles in his first home start since his injury to lead Jets to 24-3 win over Patriots

events.name: New York Giants at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — There's one play that works better than all the others for the New York Giants: throw the ball anywhere in the vicinity of Malik Nabers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Malik Nabers catches 2 TD passes from Daniel Jones as Giants hold off banged-up Browns 21-15

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — A change of scenery and an injury gave Malik Willis a huge opportunity to show what he can do in the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Malik Willis shows the Titans what they gave up, leading the Packers to a 30-14 rout

events.name: Chicago Bears at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Jonathan Taylor used his sheer strength — and a nimble cut — to give the Indianapolis Colts the jump-start they needed Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts rush for 3 TDs as struggling defense slows Bears offense for a 21-16 victory

events.name: Houston Texans at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — With the Minnesota Vikings savoring the unfamiliar vibe of being in full control in the fourth quarter, Justin Jefferson climbed on the bench to repeatedly wave his arms in encouragement of the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings stay undefeated with 34-7 dismantling of Texans behind fierce defense, Darnold's 4 TDs

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Saquon Barkley and the Eagles emerged from a flood of Philadelphia-style scrutiny and delivered a masterclass on grinding out — and closing out — a physical, defensive struggle in which a lot went wrong before it ended just right.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saquon Barkley's 2 fourth-quarter TDs lift Eagles over Saints in a defensive 15-12 thriller

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Justin Fields keeps avoiding mistakes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Fields shines as the Steelers move to 3-0 with a 20-10 win over the Chargers

events.name: Denver Broncos at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Bo Nix's first NFL touchdown pass is still to come. For now, he and the Denver Broncos will settle for celebrating the rookie quarterback's first pro win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nix runs for a TD and Lutz kicks 4 FGs to lead Broncos to 26-7 victory over listless Buccaneers

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Andy Dalton was supposed to be the veteran backup and mentor to Bryce Young, last year's No. 1 overall draft pick.
headlines.shortLinkText: Andy Dalton passes for 319 yards and 3 TDs to lead Panthers past Raiders 36-22 for first win

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Just three games into his tenure, Mike Macdonald has the Seattle Seahawks off to a perfect start and already with a two-game division lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks roll to 24-3 win over Dolphins as Miami deals with another QB injury

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson and the Baltimore Ravens had an early, emphatic answer for the first 0-2 start since before he was their franchise quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henry rushes for 151 yards, 2 TDs as Ravens hang on to beat Cowboys 28-25

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — The winless Los Angeles Rams were fresh off a 31-point loss and missing their top two receivers when they took the field Sunday against a rival that has dominated them for a half-decade.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Rams rally from a double-digit deficit to stun the 49ers 27-24 on a late field goal

events.name: Detroit Lions at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Jared Goff looked as though he might never throw an incompletion for a while Sunday, picking apart the Arizona Cardinals' defense for a pair of touchdowns in the first half.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws 2 TD passes and Lions' defense slows Kyler Murray in 20-13 win over Cardinals

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes knows he must get better.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 2 touchdown passes and the Chiefs' defense preserves a 22-17 win over the Falcons

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Any concerns Josh Allen had about how the Bills would perform following a 10-day break were eased during a 10-play opening drive that ended with James Cook scoring on a 6-yard touchdown run.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen throws 4 TD passes and the Bills roll to a 47-10 win over the unraveling Jaguars

events.name: Washington Commanders at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Jayden Daniels stood in the pocket against an all-out blitz, took a hit from Bengals safety Geno Stone and launched a perfect ball toward Terry McLaurin in the corner of the end zone. <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Jayden Daniels nearly flawless for Commanders in 38-33 win over Bengals

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: — There was a sense of relief in a somewhat subdued Dallas Cowboys locker room after a hard-fought victory over the New York Giants. There was little celebration.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott throws 2 TD passes and Cowboys win 7th straight over Giants, 20-15

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — As soon as the flag flew for pass interference, Younghoe Koo knew he would have a chance to win it for the Atlanta Falcons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Younghoe Koo's 58-yard field goal with 2 seconds left gives Falcons 26-24 win over Saints

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Once Caleb Williams and the Bears' offense found their rhythm, they started stringing together the sort of possessions the team and its fans envision on a regular basis.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams leads 4 scoring drives as Bears beat Rams 24-18

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Sam Darnold and the Minnesota Vikings keep proving skeptics wrong while maintaining early control of the NFC North race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Darnold and undefeated Vikings dominate first half and hang on to beat Packers 31-29

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — When the Indianapolis Colts needed Joe Flacco to relieve the injured Anthony Richardson, the 17-year veteran kept it simple.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Flacco relieves injured Anthony Richardson and helps Colts hold off Steelers 27-24

events.name: Denver Broncos at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Bo Nix finally threw his first NFL touchdown pass in his fourth pro start — and it came at a great time for the Denver Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nix throws his first NFL touchdown pass to help Broncos slip past Rodgers and the Jets 10-9

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers will take a 3-1 start that has them in a position to chase a fourth consecutive NFC South title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield throws for 347 yards and accounts for three TDs to lead Bucs over Eagles 33-16

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow knew coming into the game that this was as close to a must-win as you can have early in the NFL season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Burrow throws for 2 TDs, Bengals hold on to beat Panthers 34-24 for first victory of the season

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — The Houston Texans hadn't scored in the second half and had punted on five straight possessions Sunday when they got one last chance to avoid being upset by the Jacksonville Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud's TD pass with 18 seconds left lifts Texans to 24-20 win over Jaguars

events.name: Washington Commanders at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Jayden Daniels waited for a couple of blockers and then weaved forward for a 9-yard touchdown run, flipping the ball behind his back before doing a little dance and flashing a big...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie QB Daniels stars again in desert return, Commanders beat Cardinals 42-14 for 3rd straight

events.name: New England Patriots at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Even after all the success the San Francisco 49ers had the past few seasons, a two-game skid and a string of injuries early in the season can raise some doubts for any team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fred Warner's pick-6 helps the 49ers snap a 2-game skid with a 30-13 win over the Patriots

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — The Las Vegas Raiders used a strong defense as well as a balanced running game to hold off a late rally to beat the Cleveland Browns 20-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders hold off Browns rally to win 20-16 behind defense and new-found running game

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes has run through the gamut of situations in his 100 regular-season starts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce help Chiefs rally for 17-10 win over Chargers

events.name: Buffalo Bills at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Derrick Henry was off and running from the first time he touched the ball. There was no way the Buffalo Bills were stopping the Baltimore Ravens after that.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henry runs for 199 yards and Jackson has 3 TDs as Ravens rout previously unbeaten Bills 35-10

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Mason Rudolph was happy to help lead the Tennessee Titans to their first win of the season on Monday, even though he felt like he didn't have to do much.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mason Rudolph leads Titans to first win of season, 31-12 over Dolphins, after Will Levis is injured

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Jared Goff threw a perfect game, setting an NFL record by completing all 18 of his passes to help the Detroit Lions beat the Seattle Seahawks 42-29 Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff sets NFL record completing all 18 of his passes in Lions' 42-29 win over Seahawks
